title: introduce-migration-rehearsal-and-tenant-impact-scoring
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation and summary: This PR adds a migration rehearsal workflow that lets operators run a dry-run upgrade (including Helm hooks and DB schema migrations) against a shadow tenant environment and produces a tenant-impact score to prioritize rollouts. The goal is to reduce surprise rollbacks by surfacing: migration duration estimates, number of affected tenant tables, potential restore time, and a deterministic checksum timeline for assets created/removed during migration. The feature is intended for Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) where operators want an automated dry-run path that mirrors a real upgrade without touching live tenant data.

What this PR delivers (high level):
- rwi-migrate-rehearse: a CLI subcommand (installer/tools/migrate_rehearse.sh + Go binary shim) that orchestrates Terraform plan, Helm dry-run with hooks executed in a 'rehearsal' namespace, and a mocked-schema-migration runner that records operations to a migration journal.
- Tenant impact scoring service (installer/pkg/migration/impact): computes a score based on (estimated downtime, number of DB migrations, blob store deltas, rollback complexity). Output is a top-level human-readable report and machine-readable JSON artifact stored in the installer-state bucket.
- Helm chart changes: pre-upgrade hook job (templates/hooks/preflight-migration-job.yaml) capable of running migration rehearsals; hook tolerations and resource limits are conservative to avoid impacting control-plane nodes.
- Terraform changes: redwood_private_installer migration module now emits migration_plan_id and plan_summary outputs; adds a lifecycle rule to preserve rehearsal artifacts for 72 hours.
- Add-on helpers: migration-plan-diff utility that compares rehearsal journal to the current cluster state and surfaces unsafe file/secret modifications.

Checklist (manual run notes):
- [x] Add CLI glue and unit tests for tenant-impact scoring
- [x] Helm hook templates and e2e helm-dry-run integration test
- [x] Terraform outputs + docs for operators
- [x] CI e2e scenario added to perf-canary to exercise a rehearsal run

Testing and e2e: Rehearsal runs are covered by: (1) unit tests for scoring logic (pkg/migration/impact/*_test.go), (2) an integration fixture in tests/e2e/rehearse that spins up kind clusters and applies helm dry-run with the preflight job, and (3) a lightweight end-to-end canary job in deployment pipeline that validates artifact upload and plan_summary parsing. CI showed intermittent helm dry-run flakiness on older k8s versions; CI re-run passed (see ci section).

Backward compatibility and safety: This change is opt-in. Operators must enable rehearsal by setting installer.config.enableMigrationRehearsal=true in their values; by default the feature is off. Rehearsal artifacts are namespaced and use mocked migration runners unless operators opt into a read-only dry-run against a copy of tenant DB. No live tenant writes occur during default rehearsals.

Operational playbook (short):
1) terraform apply with migration module enabled (will create migration_plan_id output).
2) run rwi migrate rehearse --plan-id=<id> --tenant-sample=10 (creates artifacts under installer-state/<plan-id>/).
3) review migration-report.json and tenant-impact.json, act on high-impact tenants first, schedule canary/partial rollout.

Related work and links: Linear ENG-4201 (migration safety roadmap), ENG-4203 (rehearsal MVP). Follow-up items: automatic canary rollout integration (next PR), tighter credential scoping for rehearsal jobs.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the scoring heuristics (pkg/migration/impact/score.go), the Helm hook behavior during dry-run (templates/hooks/), and Terraform outputs (terraform/modules/migration/outputs.tf). The rehearsal uses a short-lived service account; make sure RBAC changes look reasonable.

feat(migration): tenant-impact scoring library with unit tests
chore(helm): add preflight-migration hook job and templates
infra(terraform): export migration_plan_id and plan_summary outputs
test(e2e): add rehearse e2e fixture and perf-canary scenario
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Can the scoring function be calibrated to ignore cosmetic SQL changes? Requested a patch to add a file-type whitelist to reduce false positives.
Maya Chen (author): Replied that the scoring defaults to ignoring comment-only migrations; added unit tests and a whitelist config (pkg/migration/impact/config.go).
Priya Rao: Asked for an explicit RBAC review; flagged the preflight job ServiceAccount permissions for closer scrutiny.

Maya Chen: Reduced privileges on the rehearsal ServiceAccount and added an integration test that asserts no write verbs are allowed. Added documentation about operator approval required for enabling read-only DB dry-run.
Owen Li: Noted terraform state retention window; requested we keep rehearsal artifacts for 72 hours instead of 7 to allow postmortem analysis. Adjusted lifecycle rule accordingly.

e2e (pass) — rehearse fixture completes in CI containerized kind environment
merge: notes: Follow-up PR will wire automatic canary rollout and tighten rehearsal RBAC scoping.
release_notes: Introduce optional migration rehearsal workflow and tenant-impact scoring. Adds CLI hook, Helm preflight job, Terraform outputs, and e2e tests. Opt-in feature for Private deployments to reduce rollback risk.
operator_instructions: See docs/operator/migration_rehearsal.md for full runbook. Short path: terraform apply -> rwi migrate rehearse --plan-id=<id> --tenant-sample=10 -> review installer-state/<plan-id>/migration-report.json
